fullTitle: rest/batchPublish when invoked with an array of specs performs a batch publish and returns an array of results
rest/batchPublish when invoked with a single spec performs a batch publish and returns a single result
rest/batchPresence performs a batch presence fetch and returns a result
rest/revokeTokens revokes tokens matching the given specifiers
rest/revokeTokens accepts optional issuedBefore and allowReauthMargin parameters
rest/revokeTokens throws an error when using token auth
